sources.title: e’s BAR / The Dead Poet / Lilly’s Cocktail & Wine reviews | Exa place listing
sources.text: I celebrated my 30th birthday at E’s, and I truly could not have asked for a better experience!!!!!!!!! Ajay and Mia took amazing care of us and were so attentive to our group of 23, making sure we had everything we needed to enjoy the night. The food and drinks were incredible !!! Our open bar package was immaculate and so smooth! We also ordered large platters, and everything was handled with so much care and attention. My friend and I went last night and this place was SO FUNNNNNNNNNNN! The drinks were amazing and Ruben took great care of us! Definitely will be coming back when we’re in New York again:) happy hour ends at 4p on saturdays fyi. but i fw this place, def was the 1/3 black people in here BUT the fries and smash burger are delish anddddd Franklin is the best. give him a raise 👏🏽 and there are card games! not reg cards tho if you’re trying to play spades or spoons Came to e’s Bar on a crowded weekend night with a big group of friends and had a blast! Service was prompt and friendly. Food was tasty. Tons of drink options at reasonable prices. Would recommend!

description.value: e’s BAR / The Dead Poet / Lilly’s Cocktail & Wine groups Upper West Side drinking spots for one evening. e's BAR describes itself as a neighborhood joint with good food, good drinks, fun games and smiling people, at 511 Amsterdam Ave between 84th and 85th. The Dead Poet opened in September of 2000 and celebrates famous writers, with mahogany-paneled walls and drinks named after authors. Walk-ins are welcome at e's BAR, which offers indoor and outdoor dining.
